name: Dance counts
summary: A dance reel broken into its eight counts, each a drawn stick-figure pose with a dancer looping it on the beat; friends tap the counts they have nailed, the shortest stack of faces shows where the group is stuck, and practice books the slot the stuck people can make.
useWhen: we're learning this dance for formal
which part of the tiktok dance is everyone stuck on
track who has the choreo down before the wedding
we need a practice for the group dance, when
count 6 is killing us, who still doesn't have it
dontUseWhen: a workout routine to do together (use reel-circuit)
finding a time with no dance involved (use meeting-time)
